items.title: The first world country in the grip of a poverty crisis
items.description: Once a mighty empire, Britain is now a broken kingdom. A staggering one fifth of the nation lives in poverty and that number is rising.

items.title: Chinese AI helping Iran target US forces with 'incredible precision'
items.description: Chinese satellite images enhanced by artificial intelligence could help Iran target US and allied forces to within a third of a square metre, military analysts say.

items.title: Deception campaign key to rescue of downed US fighter pilot from Iran
items.description: After an American fighter jet was shot down in a mountainous area of Iran, the US military pulled off an incredible rescue of two airmen, living up to its credo of "no man left behind", despite running into difficulty.

items.title: Iran rejects ceasefire proposal as intelligence chief killed in US-Israeli strikes
items.description: Iran says the intelligence chief of Iran's Revolutionary Guards, Major General Majid Khademi, was killed by US-Israeli strikes.

items.title: Australia's fuel shipments secured 'well into' May
items.description: Fuel shipments to Australia have been secured "well into" May, the energy minister says, as the number of service stations with diesel and petrol shortages fell over the Easter weekend.

items.title: Outback tourist pub had two visitors this Easter amid fuel price pinch
items.description: Just two tourists have stopped at the iconic Pink Roadhouse during the Easter weekend, as travellers reconsidered their Easter weekend plans due to rising fuel costs.

items.title: Aussie stars testing the waters at Australian Open
items.description: Molly O'Callaghan and Kyle Chalmers claimed Australian Open gold medals in the 100m freestyle events, while Sam Short showed his 400m rivals a clean pair of heels on night one at the Gold Coast Aquatic Centre.

items.title: Artemis II chases record for the farthest humans have ventured from Earth
items.description: The Apollo 13 crew has held the distance record for a crewed aircraft's maximum range from Earth since the 1970s. The Artemis II crew is about to change that.

items.title: The cleanest air on Earth holds a powerful lesson about our climate
items.description: Perched on Tasmania's wild north-west coast, Cape Grim has been quietly tracking the world's cleanest air for 50 years. Its data tell an interesting story about how our world has changed over half a century, including rare success stories.

items.title: 'I hate points': Gunston's last-second behind helps Hawthorn claim thriller
items.description: Hawthorn's Jack Gunston kicks a behind in the dying seconds to defeat Geelong by one point in an Easter Monday classic.

items.title: 'I don't know': Moses baffled as Eels denied in controversial Easter Monday classic
items.description: Wests Tigers five-eighth Jock Madden kicked the winning points, but Mitch Moses was left confused by a controversial call that went against the injury-ravaged Parramatta Eels.

items.title: Mayhem at Murray River race as ski boat launches into tree
items.description: Flips, spin-outs and crashes have sent four competitors to hospital as the world's fastest water ski race was held without skiers for the second straight year after fatalities in the sport in 2024.

items.title: Commuters are switching from cars to e-bikes to save money on fuel
items.description: As high fuel prices continue to affect motorists, Australians are turning to e-bikes as an alternative form of transport, with retailers reporting a surge in sales.

items.title: No Bluesfest? No worries as stars come out to wow Byron Easter crowds
items.description: There was no Bluesfest, but thousands of music fans still packed venues across the Byron Shire over the Easter long weekend.

items.title: Bic Runga thought her first album in 15 years might never arrive
items.description: "There were definitely times where I thought I was never going to make anything again," the New Zealand star says of new album Red Sunset.

items.title: Three easy sausage dinners that don't involve mash and peas
items.description: If you want some new ways to use sausages, these three easy Italian-inspired recipes will get you excited about them.

items.title: The unexpected place new collectors are finding affordable art
items.description: Horse drawings and handcrafted ceramics from local artists and artisans are among the arts and crafts you can find at the Sydney Royal Easter Show.

items.title: How one extra tree too close to your house could cost you thousands
items.description: Tree canopy coverage is being boosted in every capital city, but one micro-level analysis has found a link between property prices and the proximity of trees to houses.

items.title: Toddler dies after being pulled from water on Queensland property
items.description: An 18-month-old boy has died after being pulled from water at a private property on the Western Downs.

items.title: Angry customers who lost $10m in Zone RV collapse urge ASIC to investigate
items.description: With retirement dreams dashed, customers launch a nationwide campaign for the corporate watchdog to investigate the caravan company's former director over insolvent trading claims.

items.title: UFOs over the oval: The sighting school kids were told not to talk about
items.description: Flying saucers, balloons or mass hysteria? It's 60 years today since Australia's biggest UFO sighting took place at a Melbourne school. Witnesses are still demanding answers about what happened that day.

items.title: Christian villages in Lebanon with no affiliation to Hezbollah attacked by Israel
items.description: Bashir was injured when Israel attacked his home in a Christian village in Lebanon's south, where many residents refuse to leave despite threats of destruction.

items.title: Price crunch has some servo owners asking: 'Is it really worth doing this?'
items.description: Workers are reporting an increase in abuse from customers as service station owners say they're not making money from fuel price rises.

items.title: Up to five on the run after smashing car into Brisbane luxury store
items.description: Police say a Mercedes SUV was deliberately driven into the store in the early hours today.

items.title: Man found dead after being swept away in floodwaters in SA's far north
items.description: Police have found the body of a man in his 60s who was swept away trying to cross a flooded road on foot in SA's far north over the Easter weekend.
